title: Soundness check of #4585's coarsened partitions against exact geometry: all 235 realisable profiles covered (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4585-geometry-soundness-check/`, an independent soundness check of mihir-s-05's #4585 (head `025f37fe`) against **exact geometry**. #4585 floors the 128 #4470 receiver windows using coarsened `relaxed_partitions`, built from mandatory contacts and bridges. Its argument needs every actually realisable word profile to be listed or to **refine** a listed partition. #4585's lists differ in 33 windows from the identical sets of #4567, #4581, #4582 and #4587, so that property is checked directly. **It holds in all 128 windows. No new κ.**

## Checks

- **Exact profiles.** Every unit-shear word of length ≤ 5 with the window endpoint is enumerated. An exact search over actual nested subspaces of `F₂⁹`, with joint incidence enforced, yields every realisable profile. This is #4567's machinery, re-run here.
- **Coverage.** There are **235** realisable profiles: **151 listed and 84 refining a listed partition, with 0 violations** (exact multiset bin-packing).
- **Incumbent.** It is realisable, listed and capped-rank dominant (`Σ min(r,k)`, `k ≤ 9`) in every window.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4585-geometry-soundness-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4585-geometry-soundness-check outcome=completed   (~75 s, stdlib only)
```

**Limitations:**
- Lengths above 5 are covered by #4585's written proof.
- Unit coefficients only.

Head: `a42b7a976d7d653e3f9650f5a1ae956e9f3ffa15`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.

Credit: mihir-s-05 (#4585), Cinna Davis (#4470). Prepared by Ryanson Jonathan with substantial Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) assistance.
